datasets.name: Sentinel-1 SAR imagery
datasets.verbatim: SAR-LRA was applied over five Sentinel-1 acquisitions at 10 m resolution.

datasets.name: Globally Distributed Coseismic Landslide Dataset (GDCLD)
datasets.verbatim: The Globally Distributed Coseismic Landslide Dataset (GDCLD) is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11369484 (Fang et al., 2024a).

datasets.name: Subset of 814 landslides manually mapped within the Taiwan study area
datasets.verbatim: the subset is available on https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15027165, Novellino et al., 2025

datasets.name: Google Earth Pro archive imagery (CNES and Airbus)
datasets.verbatim: Satellite images from the Google Earth Pro archive have been used for the pre-event stage, whose collection includes data from CNES and Airbus acquired up to September 2023.

datasets.name: PlanetScope imagery
datasets.verbatim: PlanetScope imagery provider: Planet Labs PBC (2024).

methods.name: Synthetic Aperture Radar Landslide Rapid Assessment (SAR-LRA) tool
methods.summary: A tool based on convolutional neural networks that uses pre- and post-event SAR imagery in a change-detection-like approach to identify surface changes due to co-seismic slope failures.
methods.verbatim: The landslide maps have been generated using the Synthetic Aperture Radar Landslide Rapid Assessment (SAR-LRA) tool based on convolutional neural networks (Nava et al., 2024)... The tool is freely available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14898556 (Nava et al., 2025a).

data_links.name: Generated landslide inventory and ViT fine-tuning subset

code_links.name: SAR-LRA tool (code and weights)
code_links.summary: Code and model weights for the SAR-LRA tool, developed and shared by the authors.

availability.author_statement: Full availability statement, with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are referenced and linked via public repositories. The custom SAR-LRA tool code and model weights are provided via a persistent Zenodo link.
